_doc: The product's release state. `finished` flips to true ONLY through `python product/tools/release.py finish`, which refuses while any launch-checklist item in docs/LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md is still unchecked, then writes portfolio-entry.json and drops the broadcast notice for the Lojalumas portfolio agent (owner 2026-09-12: the product appears on the portfolio automatically, only when finished, clickable). Never edit `finished` by hand.
